summary: Rewritten test sets the correct file's mtime later while making it write-first and alphabetically-first, and the wrong file write-second/alphabetically-last: this defeats every realistic non-mtime proxy (name-sort-descending, append/insertion-order, ctime-vs-mtime confusion, flipped min/max comparator), which would all incorrectly select the older file; genuine mtime comparison is required to pass.
